title: OpenOLAT 20.2.2 before 20.3.12, 21.0.0 before 21.0.7, and 21.1.0 before 21.1.2 contains a missing authentication…
description: OpenOLAT versions 20.2.2 before 20.3.12, 21.0.0 before 21.0.7, and 21.1.0 before 21.1.2 have a missing authentication vulnerability in the TranscodingDeliveryDispatcher notifyResult callback endpoint. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to send crafted JSON data to overwrite transcoded video and audio files and trigger server-side requests. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity impact.
